verdict.rationale: Consensus is a hosted AI research search engine. Self-hosting or on-prem deployment is a fair openness question for a SaaS product, but the evidence pack never mentions it. The REST API and MCP server it documents are vendor-hosted access surfaces (mcp.consensus.app, subscription API keys), not a way to run the core product yourself, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
